**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The APCN 2 Construction & Maintenance Agreement imposes no non-compete or field-of-use covenant on Teleglobe USA Inc.:

- **No responsive restriction exists.** Targeted searches for "compete/competing", "restrictions", "exclusive", "field", "prohibited", "engage" and "shall not" surfaced no restrictive covenant. The only "compete" hits are "Court of competent jurisdiction" (p0272) and "competent tribunal" (p0275).
- **The Paragraph 12 capacity provisions run in our favour.** 12.20 entitles any Party to sell IRU from its Allocated Capacity "without any restrictions"; 12.22 permits making Allocated Capacity available to other Carriers "on any commercial basis without any restrictions"; 12.7 expressly permits interconnecting a WAC "with other communication systems"; and 17.4 bars Terminal Parties from impeding Direct Access.
- **Carrier-status/use conditions are not in scope.** 12.1, 12.6 and 12.13–12.15 govern how consortium capacity may be used and transferred, bind every Party equally, and must be relaxed under 12.15 as capacity expands. They do not limit what business we operate or what products we may buy or build, so they are not field-of-use restrictions under this rule and are not flagged.

No redline proposed, consistent with the instruction not to flag terms that benefit our party.
